title: When Learned IDS Model Selection Collapses to a Static Choice: A Measurement Study at the Edge
abstract: arXiv:2611.29968v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Runtime model selection trades detection quality against energy and latency. However, comparing a selector only with a more costly static detector conflates detector choice with the benefit of adaptation. We present a framework for analysis and physical measurement that combines a pairwise reward criterion, matched static controls, paired blocks, a fixed load-prevalence factorial design, and reporting of actions outside training support. On one Raspberry Pi 4B with four frozen TON-IoT detectors, tabular Q-learning and a deep Q-network (DQN) both select LightLR throughout. A retrospective audit using validation data only rules out preference reversals for MedRF versus LightLR and HeavyMLP versus LightLR. However, TinyDT has a higher reward than LightLR in seven of the 2,500 windows, so the audit does not establish global LightLR optimality. We also evaluate a causal DeadlineGuard rule under a fixed factorial design with three arrival rate

translated_title: 当学习型IDS模型选择坍缩为静态选择：一项边缘环境下的测量研究
translated_abstract: 运行时模型选择需要在检测质量与能耗和延迟之间进行权衡。然而，如果仅将学习型选择器与更昂贵的静态检测器进行比较，就会把检测器本身的选择与自适应所带来的收益混为一谈。我们提出了一个用于分析与物理测量的框架，该框架结合了成对奖励准则、匹配的静态对照、配对数据块、固定的负载-流行度因子设计，以及对训练支持范围之外动作的报告。在一台运行四个冻结TON-IoT检测器的Raspberry Pi 4B上，表格型Q学习和深度Q网络（DQN）均始终选择LightLR。一项仅使用验证数据的回顾性审计排除了MedRF相对LightLR以及HeavyMLP相对LightLR出现偏好反转的可能性。然而，TinyDT在2,500个窗口中的7个窗口获得了高于LightLR的奖励，因此该审计并不能确立LightLR的全局最优性。我们还在固定因子设计下评估了一个因果的DeadlineGuard规则，涵盖三种到达率……
tldr: 本文提出一个面向边缘IDS运行时模型选择的分析与实测框架，发现表格型Q学习和DQN选择器在树莓派上始终坍缩为选择同一静态检测器LightLR，且回顾性审计表明该选择并非全局最优。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an analysis and measurement framework for runtime IDS model selection at the edge, showing that both tabular Q-learning and DQN selectors collapse to a single static choice (LightLR) on a Raspberry Pi, and that a retrospective audit reveals this choice is not globally optimal.
